image.semantics: User red=source actual eye opening; green=source lashes; orange/yellow=old model opening/lash appearance. Makeup also rejected as unlike source.
image.limits: Manual display annotation, not a texture, exact orthographic blueprint or approval of current model. Original unmarked portrait remains the design source.

coordinates: Original received PNG pixel coordinates, no resize or warp.
meaning: Thresholded manual markup observations; line thickness/overlap uncertainty remains. Do not equate stroke extrema with exact skin vertices.
